scope: Native local-owner settings only; no wire API, shell import, real credentials or production admission.
mutation: Patch explicit names; null removes an override. Validate before atomic private replace; uncertain writes are not automatically replayed.
path: Require an existing nonempty effective PATH made of absolute entries before Agent launch. Never guess or execute a login shell.
privacy: Only overridden names and readiness leave the settings module. Values never enter Debug, logs, protocol, room messages or diagnostic exports.
